classification.difficultyReason: Weights repeated physical Os correctly, combines compulsory-letter restrictions with combinations and interprets at-most and only-letter events using cases or complements.

content.prompt: From the letters of the word TOOWOOMBA, four letters are chosen at random (without replacement). Find the probability that

answer.worked:
There are four O’s and five non-O letters. Each selection of four physical letters is equally likely.

$$\begin{align*}P(\text{no O})&=\frac{\binom{5}{4}}{\binom{9}{4}}\\P(\text{no O})&=\frac{5}{126}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: the T and exactly one O are chosen.

answer.worked:
Include T, choose one of the four O’s, then choose two of W, M, B and A.

$$\begin{align*}P(\text{T and exactly one O})&=\frac{\binom{4}{1}\binom{4}{2}}{\binom{9}{4}}\\P(\text{T and exactly one O})&=\frac{24}{126}\\P(\text{T and exactly one O})&=\frac{4}{21}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: not more than one O is chosen.

answer.worked:
Add the cases of zero O’s and exactly one O.

$$\begin{align*}P(\text{at most one O})&=\frac{\binom{5}{4}+\binom{4}{1}\binom{5}{3}}{\binom{9}{4}}\\P(\text{at most one O})&=\frac{5+40}{126}\\P(\text{at most one O})&=\frac{5}{14}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: e
children.prompt: at least one O is chosen.

answer.worked:
Use the complement of part (a).

$$\begin{align*}P(\text{at least one O})&=1-\frac{5}{126}\\P(\text{at least one O})&=\frac{121}{126}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: f
children.prompt: at least one non-O letter is chosen.

answer.worked:
Use the complement of part (b).

$$\begin{align*}P(\text{at least one non-O})&=1-\frac{1}{126}\\P(\text{at least one non-O})&=\frac{125}{126}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: g
children.prompt: only O’s and A’s are chosen.

answer.worked:
The selection contains either four O’s, or three O’s and the A.

$$\begin{align*}P(\text{only O's and A's})&=\frac{\binom{4}{4}\binom{1}{0}+\binom{4}{3}\binom{1}{1}}{\binom{9}{4}}\\P(\text{only O's and A's})&=\frac{1+4}{126}\\P(\text{only O's and A's})&=\frac{5}{126}.\end{align*}$$
